title: Cowboys PR staff wins Rozelle Award

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cowboys PR staff wins Rozelle Award
sources.description: The Cowboys public relations staff, lauded for overall professionalism with reporters who cover the franchise, were selected as the 2026 Pete Rozelle Award winner by the Professional Football Writers of America.
